aggregation.answerUnit: Each answer is judged only by the other fixed model; self-judging is forbidden.
aggregation.caseArm: Arithmetic mean of the two crossed reader/judge cells.
aggregation.naturalPrimary: FAMA on the frozen 40-case public Memora safety panel.
aggregation.capabilityPrimary: Criterion accuracy on the 70-case controlled version-capability panel.
aggregation.contextMetrics: Exact expected-state set, expected-state recall, and foreign-state contamination are recomputed from frozen recalled IDs before LLM scoring.

decisionRule: Recommend the version-aware multi-state upgrade only if every frozen gate passes against both global-latest and old/current-dual baselines. Controlled capability proves scoped behavior; public Memora is a non-inferiority safety panel.

reuse.rule: Reuse only byte-identical reader message arrays within the same frozen case.

claimBoundary: The version-capability panel is controlled and generated, but uses real Git repositories/worktrees, real SQLite writes, and the production performAutoRecall prompt path. The public safety panel is Memora at a fixed revision. This run does not measure automatic LLM extraction quality, live TCVDB/COS latency, merge ancestry inference, or prevalence on uncontrolled programming traffic.
